description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is loaded in InVesalius 3. A 3D printing technician needs a hollowed-out 'shell' model of the skull to save resin. Perform the following workflow: (1) Create a primary bone mask; (2) Create a 'core' mask by eroding the bone mask (using Morphological Operations > Erosion); (3) Create a hollow shell mask by subtracting the core from the original bone mask (Boolean Operations); (4) Generate a 3D surface of the hollow shell and export it as an STL to /home/ga/Documents/hollow_skull.stl; (5) Save the project preserving all masks to /home/ga/Documents/hollow_project.inv3.
